name: covered-call-monitor
title: Covered-Call Monitor
description: Covered-Call Monitor, by Agisilaos Papadogiannis: figures computed and corrected from the reports US funds file with the SEC (Form N-PORT).
citation: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). Covered-Call Monitor, data to 2026-07-31. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24418592

related_article.citation: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). High Yield, Capped Gains: Mechanics, Trade-Offs, and Practical Diagnostics for Covered-Call ETFs. The Journal of Beta Investment Strategies, 17(2), 110-123.
related_article.relation: Background on the strategy and on what to look at in a covered-call fund. The figures in these files are not taken from the article.

sources.title: SEC Form N-PORT data sets (US government work, public domain)

fields.name: id
fields.description: SEC series identifier of the fund (S followed by nine digits). A few funds, mostly closed-end, have none; their id is the fund name as filed

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker symbol of the fund, or of its first share class, from the SEC's list of fund tickers; empty where that list has none (closed-end funds, and funds no longer listed)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Fund name as filed in its latest report

fields.name: month
fields.description: Calendar month, YYYY-MM

fields.name: total_return_pct
fields.description: Total return on net asset value for the month in per cent, distributions reinvested, to the precision filed; empty if not filed or if the month is before the fund's first full month

fields.name: net_flow_usd
fields.description: Sales plus reinvestments less redemptions, in US dollars; empty if not filed or not used

fields.name: month_order
fields.description: as filed, reversed or not determined: how the fund's three monthly returns per report were read

fields.name: id
fields.description: SEC series identifier of the fund, or the fund name where it has none

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker symbol, where given

fields.name: name
fields.description: Fund name as filed in that report

fields.name: report_date
fields.description: Date the report describes

fields.name: filing_date
fields.description: Date the report was filed with the SEC

fields.name: net_assets_usd
fields.description: Net assets on the report date, in US dollars

fields.name: total_return_3m_pct
fields.description: Total return over the three months ending at the report date, in per cent; does not depend on month order

fields.name: net_flow_3m_usd
fields.description: Net flow over those three months, in US dollars; empty if a month was not used

fields.name: written_calls
fields.description: Number of written call positions listed on the report date. Zero for a fund that takes its call exposure through structured notes: see notes

fields.name: calls_face_value_pct_net_assets
fields.description: Contracts x 100 x strike of the written calls, as per cent of net assets. Can exceed 100. Empty if there are no calls, if it cannot be computed, or if it comes out above 200 (options on foreign indices struck in another currency), where it is not shown

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Number of structured notes held

fields.name: notes_pct_net_assets
fields.description: Market value of the structured notes as per cent of net assets. This is not the share of the portfolio that calls are written against

resources.name: funds
resources.description: One record per fund, under the key `funds`

fields.name: id
fields.description: As in the CSV files: the SEC series identifier, or the fund name where the fund has none

fields.name: name
fields.description: Fund name as filed in its latest report

fields.name: ticker
fields.description: Ticker symbol of the fund, or of its first share class, from the SEC's list of fund tickers; null where that list has none (closed-end funds, and funds no longer listed). Find those by name

fields.name: role
fields.description: fund, or benchmark for the three index funds used for comparison

fields.name: name_type
fields.description: Which of the three words the fund's name uses: Covered call, Buy-write or Premium income

fields.name: benchmark
fields.description: Ticker of the index fund this fund is set beside, chosen from the index its name states; null where the name states none of the three

fields.name: against_benchmark
fields.description: The fund and its index fund over the same months. `last_12_months` and `longest_common_period` each give `from`, `to`, the fund's and the index fund's total return in per cent over those months; the longest period also gives `months` and `gap`, the fund's cumulative return less the index fund's, in percentage points, not annualised. Use this, not two records' own figures, to compare a fund with its index fund. Null where there is no benchmark

fields.name: still_reporting
fields.description: False if the fund's latest report is more than six months older than the newest report on file. Such funds are kept, so the history has no survivorship gap, but they are not counted in the category

fields.name: first_report, latest_report, latest_filing
fields.description: Dates of the first and latest quarterly report on file and the date the latest was filed

fields.name: reports
fields.description: Number of quarterly reports on file

fields.name: months, first_month, latest_month
fields.description: Number of months with a total return, and the first and last of them. monthly.csv can hold earlier rows for the same fund that carry a net flow but no return. For a fund whose month order is not determined, first_month can be off by up to two months

fields.name: net_assets_usd
fields.description: Net assets on latest_report, in US dollars

fields.name: total_return_pct
fields.description: Total returns on net asset value, in per cent, over the 3, 12, 36 and 60 months ending at `to` (the month of latest_report). The 36 and 60 month figures are annualised. Null where the fund has too few months

fields.name: month_order.order
fields.description: as filed, reversed or not determined: how the three monthly returns of each report were read

fields.name: month_order.compared_with
fields.description: Ticker of the index fund whose months fitted this fund best, out of the three benchmarks. It is used only to decide the order and need not be the fund's own market; null if fewer than four reports could be compared

fields.name: month_order.misfit_as_filed, misfit_reversed
fields.description: Sum over the compared reports of the squared differences, in percentage points, between the fund's and the index fund's monthly returns, under each reading. The order is decided only if one misfit is less than half the other

fields.name: month_order.reports_compared
fields.description: Number of reports used in that comparison

fields.name: written_calls.positions
fields.description: Number of written call positions listed in the latest report

fields.name: written_calls.face_value_pct_net_assets
fields.description: Contracts x 100 x strike, as per cent of net assets. Can exceed 100 when a fund writes calls on more than it holds or the index is above the strike basis. Null if there are no calls, if it cannot be computed, or if it comes out above 200, where it is not shown

fields.name: written_calls.strikes_taken_from_title
fields.description: Number of positions whose strike was repaired from the holding's title

fields.name: written_calls.nearest_expiration
fields.description: Earliest expiration date among the written calls, as filed

fields.name: call_exposure_in_notes
fields.description: True if the fund lists no written calls but holds structured notes. Its call exposure sits inside the notes, and the filing gives neither strikes nor the share of the portfolio covered

fields.name: no_overlay_on_report_date
fields.description: True if the latest report lists neither written calls nor structured notes. This does not mean the fund writes no options: a fund that writes options expiring the same day, or that had rolled out of its position, has none on its books at the report date

fields.name: structured_notes
fields.description: Number of structured notes, their market value as per cent of net assets, and their issuers

fields.name: flow_months_not_used
fields.description: Months whose net flow is left out because the filing reports negative sales or redemptions
